title: Counting color-critical subgraphs under Nikiforov's condition
summary: For a graph $G$ with $m$ edges, let $ρ(G)$ be its spectral radius, and let $N_F(G)$ denote the number of copies of $F$ in $G$. Nikiforov [Combin. Probab.\,Comput., 2002] proved that for $r\geq 2$, if $ρ(G)>\sqrt{(1-1/r)2m}$, then $N_{K_{r+1}}(G)\geq 1$. Furthermore, Bollobás and Nikiforov [J. Combin. Theory, Ser. B, 2007] used $ρ(G)$ to establish a counting inequality for complete subgraphs. In this paper, we generalize and strengthen the above results to any color-critical graph $F$ with chromatic number at least four.
